resources.string: Allow mobile data for this download
Download the required Google language packs? About 30 MB per language. Wi-Fi is used unless you allow mobile data. Downloaded languages can then work offline.
Preparing translation… A language download may wait for Wi-Fi.
Translation unavailable. Check your connection if language packs need downloading, then try again.
The text or selection has changed. Select it again; nothing was replaced.
Hold the title to move this window.
Translate selected text and review it before replacing it

Choose Translation for a keyboard bar button. Select text, tap that button, choose the source and target languages, then review or edit the proposal before accepting. Supported physical touchpads can navigate the language list and preview actions with vertical swipes and a double tap.
Google ML Kit. Languages are downloaded with your permission; translation then runs on your device.
Only text can be pasted into a translation proposal.
Download the offline Bergamot language pair (about 27 MB). Text is translated on this device.
Bergamot currently supports French ↔ English. Choose Google for other languages.
The API server is detected automatically. Verification sends no text to translate.
DeepL is busy. Try again later.
Send the selected text to DeepL for online translation? This uses your API allowance. Saved corrections remain on this device.
DeepL rejected this key. Check that it is active and belongs to an API plan.
Paste the complete API key from the API Keys section of your DeepL account.
A key is already saved. Leave this field empty to keep it.
The key could not be saved on this device.
DeepL cannot process this language pair or request.
Configure your personal DeepL API key in the translation settings.
Unable to reach DeepL. Check your Internet connection.
Requires your personal DeepL API account. Selected text is sent to DeepL over the Internet. Usage depends on your API plan.
Developer offer: a total free credit of 1 million characters, without renewal. Check current DeepL terms.
Keep an offline engine as default and choose “Try with DeepL” in the preview when needed.
The key stays on this device and is excluded from backup ZIPs.
DeepL API allowance reached. Choose an offline engine or check your DeepL account.
Quota unavailable. The last reading may be outdated.
Experimental · French ↔ English. Preserves stretched yes, no and greetings when the translated word is unambiguous.
Preserves !!, ?!, … and line breaks without forcing identical sentence structure.
